name: On-device AI (Foundation Models)
description: Text generation and structured output with Apple's on-device language model, behind an availability check so the feature hides itself on unsupported devices.

cost.note: On-device; no API key or per-request cost

usage: Show AI features only when `OnDeviceAI.isAvailable` is true (iOS 26 or later with Apple Intelligence enabled). Use `OnDeviceAI.respond(to:instructions:)` for one-shot text, or create a `LanguageModelSession` inside an `if #available(iOS 26.0, *)` block for multi-turn or `@Generable` structured output. Keep prompts short and never send personal data elsewhere; the model runs on device.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify foundation-models` on a Mac with Xcode.
